description: February 19 birthday meaning: Aquarius or Pisces cusp, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, February 19 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Aquarius or Pisces. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: February 19 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Pisces season traditionally opens around February 19, and in most years the Sun has reached the first degree of Neptune's mutable water sign by noon. Births in some years, or early in the day, may still be late Aquarius. The 19 reduces to 1, giving dreamy Pisces a decisive edge and Aquarius a softer, more intuitive one.

On February 19 the Sun usually sits at about 0° Pisces, in the first decan, where Neptune rules the decan as well as the sign. The Aquarius–Pisces cusp, around February 17 to February 20, joins two of the most idealistic signs in the zodiac. Born here, your Sun sign is set by year, hour and birthplace, because the Sun's entry into Pisces does not fall on the same day every year; a natal chart resolves it. Those who feel both are often described as imaginative humanitarians, combining Aquarius' ideas about how the world could be with Pisces' compassion for the people living in it. They may drift between detachment and deep feeling, and learn to use each when it helps.

sections.heading: February 19 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 19th, the compound 1 + 9 makes 10, which reduces to 1. The birthday number is therefore 1, reached through the full span of the single digits from first to last. Numerologists sometimes call 19 a karmic debt number associated with learning to accept help. People born on this day are frequently described as fiercely independent, resourceful and determined to do things their own way. The 9 in the compound adds compassion and a broad outlook to the 1's drive. As a secondary number, it tends to reward asking for support without seeing it as weakness.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one February 19 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 11 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on February 19: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 19 is the 50th day of the year. By March 21, 31 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Aries.

For the Chinese zodiac, February 19 sits inside the Lunar New Year window: in 120 of the 121 years from 1924 to 2044 the new year has already begun by this date, so check the year before choosing an animal. Well-known people born on February 19 include Cristina Fernández de Kirchner (1953), Svante August Arrhenius (1859) and Saparmyrat Nyýazow (1940).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 19?
faq.answer: February 19 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Aquarius or Pisces on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Pisces. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 19?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 19 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 11 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 19th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 19?
faq.answer: February 19 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 120 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 19?
faq.answer: February 19 is also the birthday of Cristina Fernández de Kirchner (1953), Svante August Arrhenius (1859) and Saparmyrat Nyýazow (1940). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
